content.short: Inspex Explorer provides cybersecurity services focused on blockchain and smart contract audits.
content.description: Inspex Explorer is a blockchain and smart contract threat intelligence and incident-response service. It provides a Security Monitoring Dashboard that delivers information to users and supports investigations into security incidents affecting decentralized applications (dapps). By combining threat intelligence with incident-response capabilities, the platform helps users monitor, understand, and respond to security events within the blockchain ecosystem.
